runsheet.short_description: Disconnect webinar audio+video from the auditorium.
[[Webinar Sentinel On-Site]] confirm where [[Zoom Master]] will sit.
Make sure the on-site/online Speaker has arrived. Greet the Speaker, mention time cue signals, and direct them to the [[Zoom Master]] for setup.

runsheet.more_info: Chat > menu > attendees can chat with: nobody.

runsheet.short_description: In the Zoom webinar, promote the Speaker, [[Q&A Producer]], and [[Webinar Sentinel On-Site]] to panelist; and backstage to cohost.

Help the Speaker connect laptop to HDMI (if on their own laptop), test aduio+video input+output (if online), and test screenshare and sound share (always). Direct the Speaker to the [[Q&A Producer]] for coordination.
Ask whether the Speaker will take questions during the talk. Agree on the Q&A signal with the Speaker.
Grab a mic and keep it for the whole session.
Connect webinar audio+video to the auditorium.

Sit in the corner of the stage. Join Zoom on the provided laptop and disconnect audio+video. Keep both the Q&A panel and the participants view (for raised hands) open at all times. Balance online VS on-site questions.
runsheet.more_info: If the on-site Speaker does not notice your signal and keeps taking on-site questions, politely barge in.

runsheet.short_description: Start the session. Introduce the Speaker. Speaker starts. Sit in the corner of the stage with the [[Q&A Producer]].

Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar on the provided laptop. Not only listen, but try to understand and enjoy the talk --- you catch more issues this way. Keep the on-site screen visible so any mismatch is catched, but pay main attention to the webinar. Use the provided headphones. Upon issues, use judgement: Either unmute to raise the issue, or contact the [[Zoom Master]] immediately by walking to them.
Remind the Speaker of time elapsed; during Q&A, keep track of time.
Sit in the corner of the audience to enjoy the talk.
Whenever a question from the on-site audience is taken, give your mic to them.
Demote panelists to attendees, especially when there is a subsequent session.
Monitor the Webinar and report issues immediately to [#vol-alerts](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CDNPPNJ0Z).
